Find the root cause of a Trade-Bot failure and prepare a targeted, regression-tested fix.
Review a proposed Trade-Bot change for safety, quality, runtime, and PR-readiness gaps.
Apply Cookbook-inspired evaluation and safe SDK patterns without weakening trading controls.
